title: Snipetron
extract:
The Snipetron is a  Corpus built sniper rifle. Its high focus on  Puncture damage makes it an ideal weapon for use against Corpus and Orokin targets.
This weapon can be sold for  7,500.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Puncture damage.
Two zoom modes:
First zoom has 2.5x zoom distance and +25% headshot damage.
Second zoom has 6.0x zoom distance and +50% headshot damage.
Innate  polarity.
Advantages over other Primary  Sniper Rifle weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Pinpoint accuracy while zoomed in; shots will hit exactly on the reticle dot, perfect for headshots.
Innate 2.5 meter punch through.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
High crit chance (30.00%)
Above average fire rate (2.00 attacks/sec)
Very high ammo max (72)
High disposition (●●●●○ (1.30x))
Disadvantages over other Primary  Sniper Rifle weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Has linear damage falloff from 100% to 50% from 400m to 600m target distance (distances are affected by Projectile Speed).
Inaccurate beyond short range when fired from the hip.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Very low active falloff slope (400.0m/%)
Very low burst DPS (414)
Very low sustained DPS (150.54)
Very low magazine size (4)
Very low total damage (180)
Very low ammo pickup (15)
Very low accuracy (0.00° to 15.00°)
Very low reload speed (3.50 s)
Very low damage per shot (207)
Very low status chance (12.00%)
Very low crit multiplier (1.50x)
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Acquisition
The blueprint occasionally returns as an offering sold by Nakak in Cetus during the Operation: Plague Star event for  3,000 Operational Supply and  5,000.
The blueprint is available from Ticker in Fortuna during the Star Days event for 8  Advances Debt-Bonds.

Notes
Using  Wildfire and  Magazine Warp on their own will give you one bullet each, while using both at the same time will give you two extra bullets.
Originally the Snipetron was available from the Market, but it was retired since Update 8.0 (2013-05-23) due to lore issues where the Corpus do not utilize weapons that fire bullets, but rely on energy weapons or railgun technology.
Players were previously able to obtain a  Snipetron Vandal and a Blueprint for the normal Snipetron through the Informant Event after killing 20 Informers. The developers admitted that this was an apology for the Snipetron's sudden removal. Following the event, any piece of content to be removed from the market is now given a week's advance notice.
The Snipetron blueprint was added as a reward for the Project Undermine Tactical Alert from the 2nd of October 2015 to the 5th of October 2015.

Tips
Use your melee or your sidearm for close-quarters combat.
The  Bronco (Prime),  Akbronco (Prime),  Brakk,  Euphona Prime,  Twin Rogga, and  Detron (Mara) all make for an excellent complement to the Snipetron, covering close range battles where the Snipetron suffers.
As a general note, ammo consumption should not be too big of an issue as long as players make full use of their abilities and melee weapons in conjunction with Snipetron.
Use the  Sniper Ammo Mutation mod to greatly relieve the low total ammo and ammo drop chance for sniper rifles.
Alternatively, bring Squad Ammo Restore or use Carrier's  Ammo Case.
Like all sniper rifles, the Snipetron works well with Warframes with mobility-boosting abilities such as  Zephyr or  Nova.

Trivia
As this was the first true sniper rifle in the game, Grineer Ballista were equipped with this weapon before the  Vulkar was introduced.
The Snipetron shares an identical appearance with the  Lanka, which effectively replaced it as the Corpus sniper rifle.
